description: This file defines classes and methods for managing contact information within the Odoo (formerly OpenERP) framework, including contact details, addresses, and associated jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_contact
classes.description: Model for contact details associated with a partner, including name, title, contact info, and related jobs.

classes.name: res_partner_address
classes.description: Model for partner addresses, with custom name display logic.

classes.name: res_partner_job
classes.description: Model representing a contact's role or function at a partner, including contact info and employment dates.

methods.name: _title_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of titles with 'contact' domain for selection.

methods.name: _main_job
methods.description: Computes the main job for a contact based on related job records.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns a display name for contact records, combining title, name, and first name.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches contacts by name or first name with specified operator.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Overrides name display for partner addresses, showing either partner name or address string.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns a display string for a contact's job, including function if available.

methods.name: onchange_partner
methods.description: Resets address when partner is changed.

methods.name: onchange_address
methods.description: Updates partner ID based on selected address.
